description: Filter configuration (CSS or SVG filter primitives)

mode.description: Filter mode - CSS filters or SVG filter primitives
enumDescriptions: CSS filters (blur, brightness, contrast, etc.) - simpler, good performance
SVG filter primitives (feGaussianBlur, feColorMatrix, etc.) - more powerful, complex effects

type.description: Filter type - depends on mode (CSS: blur, brightness, etc. / SVG: feGaussianBlur, feColorMatrix, etc.)

blur.description: Gaussian blur radius, a CSS length in px.

brightness.description: 0 = black, 1 = normal, 2+ = brighter. No hard ceiling in code; 3 is a practical UI limit.

contrast.description: 0 = gray, 1 = normal, 2+ = higher contrast. No hard ceiling in code; 3 is a practical UI limit.

saturate.description: 0 = grayscale, 1 = normal, 2+ = oversaturated. No hard ceiling in code; 3 is a practical UI limit.

hue-rotate.description: Angle to rotate hue by, a CSS angle in deg (0-360 is the meaningful range; it wraps beyond that).

grayscale.description: 0 = full color, 1 = complete grayscale. CSS-spec-clamped to 0-1.

sepia.description: 0 = normal, 1 = full sepia tone. CSS-spec-clamped to 0-1.

opacity.description: 0 = fully transparent, 1 = fully opaque. CSS-spec-clamped to 0-1; values above 1 have no additional effect.

blur.description: Shadow blur radius, a CSS length in px.

feGaussianBlur.description: SVG Gaussian blur: smoother than CSS blur, chains with other SVG filters.

stdDeviation.description: Amount of blur: 0 = none, higher = more blur.

feColorMatrix.description: Color transformation via matrix operations: hue rotation, saturation, luminance-to-alpha, or a custom 4x5 matrix.

oneOf.description: Saturation multiplier (type: saturate) or hue-rotate angle in degrees (type: hueRotate).
4x5 matrix as an array: 20 numbers (type: matrix).

values.description: Meaning depends on `type`. Not used when type is luminanceToAlpha.

feOffset.description: Shifts the filter result by dx/dy pixels; combine with blur for shadow effects.

dx.description: Horizontal offset: positive = right, negative = left.

dy.description: Vertical offset: positive = down, negative = up.

feBlend.description: Blends the current filter result with SourceGraphic using a standard CSS blend mode.

mode.description: Blend mode: try screen/lighten after a blur for glow effects.

feComposite.description: Combines the previous filter result and SourceGraphic using a Porter-Duff operator, or a custom arithmetic formula.

k1.description: Arithmetic coefficient: only used when operator is arithmetic. result = k1*i1*i2 + k2*i1 + k3*i2 + k4.

k2.description: Arithmetic coefficient: only used when operator is arithmetic.

k3.description: Arithmetic coefficient: only used when operator is arithmetic.

k4.description: Arithmetic coefficient: only used when operator is arithmetic.

feMorphology.description: Erodes (thins) or dilates (fattens) shapes, useful for outlines or edge-thickness adjustment.

radius.description: How far to erode/dilate, in filter units.

feTurbulence.description: Generates Perlin noise for organic textures, commonly paired with feDisplacementMap.

seed.description: Randomization seed: change for a different pattern.

feDisplacementMap.description: Warps the image based on color values from a preceding source (typically feTurbulence): wavy/liquid/turbulent distortion.

tint.description: Composites a flat color wash over the content: a cheap alert/status tint. Requires an SVG root (not supported on data-grid).

color.description: Tint color: the alpha channel controls how much content shows through.

value.description: Filter parameters - shape depends on the sibling `type` field. Simple value for CSS filters, object for SVG filters.
